Obtain the full text of the 2026 wheat seed-system review and local varietal performance data to connect seed replacement and varietal choice with farm-level yields without assuming national genetic-gain figures apply uniformly.
For the 2026/27 campaign, obtain basin-level irrigation allocations and farm tariffs; national dam storage cannot be translated into farm water availability or irrigation cost.

For seed, fertilizer and pesticide records, capture registered product/formulation and conformity evidence alongside dated supplier invoices; ONSSA's control framework confirms that input quality and labelling matter independently of price.

For Marchouch and other cereal/lentil zones, obtain 2026/27 diesel invoices or pump receipts, litres consumed by operation and hectare, and dated tractor/harvester hire quotations; the May 2026 interview provides only one farmer's MAD 1,200-to-1,800/ha tractor-diesel comparison and an unquantified machinery-rental increase.

For livestock-feed costs, obtain supplier invoices that state sack weight, feed formulation, location and date; the May 2026 reported MAD 90-to-110–120 per sack comparison lacks the unit details needed for a per-kg calculator input.
conclusion: Morocco remains research-only. The evidence register now contains 13 source records, including May 2026 farmer testimony on tractor-diesel and machinery-hire cost pressures. These are useful as dated stress indicators only: the diesel figure is one farmer's tractor-operation spending, machinery hire has no absolute rate, and feed sack weights/formulations are unspecified. Existing seasonal, regulatory and crop-survey evidence still does not provide a complete, current, representative farm budget or verified current input invoices. No calculator data are activated.
